description: This source file contains the implementation of the SigfoxProtocolAdapter class, which is a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for Sigfox devices. It handles HTTP requests for telemetry data and commands, manages authentication, and customizes downstream messages to include query parameters.

classes.name: SigfoxProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for handling Sigfox device communication, including receiving telemetry data, sending commands, and managing authentication.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for authenticating devices using username and password credentials.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider that determines tenant and authentication ID based on the HTTP context.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of this protocol adapter type.

methods.name: setupAuthorization
methods.description: Configures authorization handlers for the router, including basic auth and chain handlers.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Defines HTTP routes for telemetry and event data, adding handlers for data processing and error management.

methods.name: dataCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates a CORS handler allowing specified HTTP headers and methods.

methods.name: dataHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming data requests, validating tenant info and decoding payloads.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Adds query parameters starting with 'sigfox.' to the downstream message's application properties.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.description: Decodes a hex-encoded string into a Buffer.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnectFromRequest
methods.description: Determines the time until disconnect based on 'ack' query or header parameter.

methods.name: isCommandValid
methods.description: Validates if a command object is suitable for sending, checking payload size, direction, and presence.

methods.name: setEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets a 204 No Content response for acknowledgments with no payload.

methods.name: setNonEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets a 200 OK response with a JSON payload for commands.

methods.name: convertToResponsePayload
methods.description: Creates a JSON Buffer containing the payload in hex encoding for downstream.
